exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-23T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix issue-
exec card config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential

# Durable IDs use the public issue-ID grammar at the apply boundary.
! exec card apply invalid-target.json
! stdout .
stderr 'issues\[0\].id'
stderr '\[A-Za-z0-9\]\[A-Za-z0-9-\]\*'

! exec card apply invalid-reference.json
! stdout .
stderr 'issues\[0\].depends_on.values\[0\].id'
stderr '\[A-Za-z0-9\]\[A-Za-z0-9-\]\*'

# Apply-local aliases and external keys retain their separate contracts.
exec card apply separate-namespaces.json
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/applied.txt
exec card --json show issue-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/issue.json

# Prefix configuration cannot produce an ID outside the durable grammar.
! exec card config set --scope board issue.id.prefix -
! stdout .
stderr 'start with a letter or digit'

-- invalid-target.json --
{"version":1,"issues":[{"id":"issue_bad","title":"Bad target","type":"task"}]}
-- invalid-reference.json --
{"version":1,"issues":[{"title":"Bad dependency","type":"task","depends_on":{"values":[{"id":"issue/bad"}]}}]}
-- separate-namespaces.json --
{"version":1,"issues":[{"alias":"local_alias/path","key":" producer_key/path ","title":"Separate namespaces","type":"task"}]}
-- golden/applied.txt --
applied document: 1 create, 0 update, 0 skip, 0 no change
0	create	issue-1
-- golden/issue.json --
{"id":"issue-1","title":"Separate namespaces","type":"task","lifecycle":"open","status":"ready","priority":2,"active_claim":null,"created":1784808000,"updated":1784808000,"revision":2,"keys":[" producer_key/path "],"labels":[],"depends_on":[],"blocks":[],"log_count":0,"blocked":false,"parent_id":null,"attachments":[]}
